paragraphs: EFORCE Software sells web-based software to law enforcement agencies, built to raise productivity and improve record quality. It also offers tools for corrections staff, which the company says were built by corrections staff. A further set of tools serves municipal courts. The company says it built its own suite of web-based software from the ground up on the idea that law enforcement software should be advanced but easy to use.

EFORCE has served the law enforcement industry since 2003. It says it was the first to deliver a suite of browser-based solutions of this kind. The stated goal is to reduce time spent in the office so officers get back to the field. More than 20% of its employees have been Patrol Officers, Detectives, Dispatchers, Jailers or Administrators.

The homepage says agencies of all sizes from across the country use the software. Testimonials there are attributed to agencies including the Jacksonville Police Department. One of those testimonials singles out the software being web-based and accessible from anywhere. The company counts more than 20 years designing and implementing software for public safety agencies.

quote.text: EFORCE® was founded on the idea that law enforcement software should be technologically advanced, but easy to use
